claim.statement: Current Lovable documentation says browser testing runs in a remote virtual environment against the current project preview, can interact with flows and inspect console and network activity, and may use the current preview user's authenticated session.

source.title: Test your app in a browser

limitations: Authenticated browser testing may exercise the current app user's authority; no target or side effect was observed here.
